title: Freeze-thaw impacts on physicochemical properties and mineral–organic components of various loess soils
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00241B, Paper
Zhongwei Yang, Yifan Yao, Yufeng Jiang, Jingru Diao, Longmiao Yuan, Yingqin Wu
Freeze-thaw cycles (FTCs) are a critical factor in the environmental changes of soils in cold regions, significantly impacting their structure and composition through physical stress and chemical migration resulting from water freezing and thawing.
